profile.name: 化学气相沉积工艺控制系统
profile.name_en: Chemical Vapor Deposition Process Control System
profile.description: 用于化学气相沉积（CVD）实验的工艺控制系统，通常配合反应腔、加热炉和多路气体流量控制部件使用。它用于设置与执行沉积配方、调整温度和气体流量参数，并监看工艺过程中的趋势变化，适合薄膜生长与材料制备实验。
profile.description_en: A chemical vapor deposition (CVD) process control system used with a reactor chamber, heater or furnace, and multiple gas flow control components. It is used to define and run deposition recipes, adjust temperature and gas flow parameters, and monitor process trends during thin-film growth and materials synthesis experiments.

Chemical Vapor Deposition Process Control System
用于化学气相沉积（CVD）实验的工艺控制系统，通常配合反应腔、加热炉和多路气体流量控制部件使用。它用于设置与执行沉积配方、调整温度和气体流量参数，并监看工艺过程中的趋势变化，适合薄膜生长与材料制备实验。

A chemical vapor deposition (CVD) process control system used with a reactor chamber, heater or furnace, and multiple gas flow control components. It is used to define and run deposition recipes, adjust temperature and gas flow parameters, and monitor process trends during thin-film growth and materials synthesis experiments.
